_doc: Equipment for the Warrior line: the Warrior-bit weapons of the sword (130xxxx, 140xxxx), axe (131xxxx, 141xxxx), blunt (132xxxx, 142xxxx), spear (143xxxx) and polearm (144xxxx) families and the Warrior shields (109xxxx), every non-cash item with reqLevel 0-70 and a reqJob that has the Warrior bit (1; some are shared with Thieves and Bowmen), dropped by an ordinary mob or sold by a regular NPC shop in a v83 server (tier B, same rule as ../equipment_drops.json). reqJob 0 weapons and shields stay out on purpose: a Beginner holds a sword, and the Beginner and Magician drops must not change. Daggers, bows, crossbows, claws, knuckles and guns belong to the other class specs; Magician and Thief shields are theirs too. Selection rules: see ../equipment_drops.json _doc. Late bands (#474, spec #449 C12): extended to reqLevel 120 with every ordinary v83 item of the class in Character.wz (not cash, `only`, `notSale`, `quest`, `timeLimited`, tradeBlock flags, price above 1, named, no GMS item; tier C, GAME_DESIGN 8.3); armour one per slot, reqJob, reqLevel and gender, weapons all; new items from reqLevel 41, plus Warrior and Pirate armour of 35-40 for the step-6 band.
